| 本文评估 `CYLTheme`（换肤组件，[docs/Theme-Switching.md](Theme-Switching.md)）的实现，以及它与 Lottie、PAG、Rive 三个动画组件（[docs/Tab-Bar-Item-Animation.md](Tab-Bar-Item-Animation.md)）的集成方式：每一项按满分 100 分打分，列出与目标（QMUI 的 QMUITheme 的能力范围、最初的架构设计）之间的差距，并给出具体改进。评估分两个时间点：本次提交之前（只有主题颜色）与本次提交之后（新增主题图片、主题模糊效果、layer 颜色、离屏视图的自动刷新与测试）。 | This document evaluates the implementation of `CYLTheme` (the theme switching component, [docs/Theme-Switching.md](Theme-Switching.md)) and how it is integrated with the three animation components, Lottie, PAG and Rive ([docs/Tab-Bar-Item-Animation.md](Tab-Bar-Item-Animation.md)). Every area is scored out of 100, the gap to the target (what QMUI's QMUITheme covers, and the original architecture) is named, and each gap gets a concrete fix. Two points in time are scored: before this commit (theme colors only) and after it (theme images, theme blur effects, layer colors, automatic refresh of off-screen views, and tests). |

## [CN]结论
## [EN]Summary

| 中文 | English |
|:---|:---|
| 换肤组件本身从 86 分提升到 95 分：QMUI 的四项能力差距中，图片、模糊效果、自动刷新三项已补齐，且仍然不 hook 任何 UIKit 方法；测试从 8 个增加到 14 个，覆盖了新增的三种主题值。剩下的 5 分在 iOS 12 以前的动态颜色（无法解决，系统限制）与截图。 | The theme component itself goes from 86 to 95: of the four capability gaps to QMUI, images, blur effects and automatic refresh are closed, still without swizzling a single UIKit method; the tests go from 8 to 14 and cover the three new kinds of theme value. The remaining 5 points are dynamic colors before iOS 13 (a system limit, cannot be fixed) and screenshots. |
| 换肤与动画组件的集成是真正的短板：72 分。主题可以换 TabBar 的静态图标与颜色，却不能换一个 Tab 的 Lottie / PAG / Rive 动画文件，也不能把主题颜色传进动画（`CYLTabBarAnimationDarkColors` 只认深色模式，不认主题）；动画引擎只监听 Dark Mode，不监听主题切换。三条改进（下文第 5 节）都只在现有协议上加可选方法，不改公开 API。 | The integration of theming with the animation components is the real weak spot: 72. A theme can swap the tab bar's static icons and colors, but cannot swap a tab's Lottie / PAG / Rive file, and cannot feed theme colors into an animation (`CYLTabBarAnimationDarkColors` knows Dark Mode, not themes); the animation engine listens to Dark Mode, never to a theme change. The three fixes (section 5 below) only add optional methods to the existing protocols; no public API changes. |
| 对最初架构设计的符合度：换肤组件符合（单一入口 `CYLThemeManager`，视图通过回调而非 hook 跟随，TabBar 通过 `CYLTabBarTheme` 协议面向接口）；动画组件符合（两层依赖反转，引擎只认协议）；两者的**接缝**不符合——它们各自完整，但彼此不知道对方存在，主题到动画之间没有协议。 | Fit with the original architecture: the theme component fits (one entry point, `CYLThemeManager`; views follow through callbacks, not hooks; the tab bar is programmed to the `CYLTabBarTheme` interface); the animation component fits (dependency inversion on two levels, the engine sees protocols only); the **seam** between them does not: each is complete on its own, but neither knows the other exists, and there is no protocol from a theme to an animation. |

## [CN]1. 换肤组件：逐项评估
## [EN]1. The theme component, area by area

### [CN]1.1 主题颜色（95 分，不变）
### [EN]1.1 Theme colors (95, unchanged)

| 中文 | English |
|:---|:---|
| `+[UIColor cyl_colorWithThemeProvider:]` 返回 iOS 13 的动态颜色，绘制时向 provider 取值；主题切换时已注册属性得到新副本以触发重绘（UIKit 对同一对象跳过赋值）。与 QMUI 的 `UIColor+QMUITheme` 能力相同，且不需要 hook `UIColor`。扣分：iOS 12 及以前只能是静态值，这是系统限制。 | `+[UIColor cyl_colorWithThemeProvider:]` returns an iOS 13 dynamic color that asks the provider when drawn; a theme change gives registered properties a fresh copy so UIKit redraws (it skips assigning the very same object). Same capability as QMUI's `UIColor+QMUITheme`, without hooking `UIColor`. Deduction: a static value before iOS 13, a system limit. |

### [CN]1.2 主题图片（0 → 92 分）
### [EN]1.2 Theme images (0 → 92)

| 中文 | English |
|:---|:---|
| 之前：没有。文档「限制」一节明确写着"不提供动态图片"。App 中任何想跟随主题的 `UIImageView` / `UIButton` 都要自己监听 `CYLThemeDidChangeNotification`。这是与 QMUI 最大的差距（QMUI 的 `UIImage+QMUITheme` 用一个 `QMUIThemeImage` 子类，并 hook `UIImageView.image` 等 setter 来做到）。 | Before: none. The "Limits" section of the doc said so: "no dynamic images". Any `UIImageView` / `UIButton` in the app that wanted to follow the theme had to observe `CYLThemeDidChangeNotification` itself. This was the largest gap to QMUI (whose `UIImage+QMUITheme` uses a `QMUIThemeImage` subclass and hooks setters such as `UIImageView.image`). |
| 之后：`+[UIImage cyl_imageWithThemeProvider:]`（`UIImage+CYLTheme.h`）。设计取舍：**不做子类，不做 hook**。主题图片是 provider 返回的当前主题图片经 `-imageWithAlignmentRectInsets:` 得到的新对象（保留 asset catalog 的深色变体、渲染模式与 SF Symbol 配置），并通过关联对象记住 provider。主题切换时 `UIView (CYLTheme)` 在不 hook 的前提下替换：`UIImageView.image` / `highlightedImage`、`UIButton` 各状态的 image 与 backgroundImage（没有单独设置的状态跳过，继续跟随 normal）、已注册属性、Bar appearance 的 `backgroundImage` / `shadowImage`。 | After: `+[UIImage cyl_imageWithThemeProvider:]` (`UIImage+CYLTheme.h`). The design choice: **no subclass, no hook**. A theme image is the provider's current image passed through `-imageWithAlignmentRectInsets:` (a new object that keeps the asset catalog Dark Mode variant, the rendering mode and the SF Symbol configuration) that remembers its provider through an associated object. On a theme change `UIView (CYLTheme)` replaces it, still without a hook: `UIImageView.image` / `highlightedImage`, every state's image and backgroundImage of a `UIButton` (a state without its own image is skipped, so it keeps following normal), the registered properties, and the `backgroundImage` / `shadowImage` of the bar appearances. |
| 为什么不用 QMUI 的方案：`UIImage` 子类会在 `UITabBarItem.selectedImage`、`CGImage` 等只保存静态副本的地方失效（原文档已指出），而 hook `setImage:` 会与 SDWebImage、Kingfisher 等同样 hook 的库冲突，这正是本库从一开始就排除 hook 的理由。 | Why not QMUI's way: a `UIImage` subclass breaks wherever only a static copy is kept (`UITabBarItem.selectedImage`, `CGImage`; the doc said so already), and hooking `setImage:` clashes with libraries that hook it too, SDWebImage and Kingfisher among them. That is the reason this library ruled hooks out from the start. |
| 扣分（−8）：`UIButtonConfiguration.image`、`UITabBarItem.image`、`NSTextAttachment.image` 这些不是视图属性的位置，仍要在 `cyl_themeDidChangeBlock` 中重设（TabBar 图标请用 `CYLTabBarTheme`）。 | Deduction (−8): images that are not view properties, `UIButtonConfiguration.image`, `UITabBarItem.image`, `NSTextAttachment.image`, still need `cyl_themeDidChangeBlock` (tab bar icons: use `CYLTabBarTheme`). |

### [CN]1.3 主题模糊效果（0 → 90 分）
### [EN]1.3 Theme blur effects (0 → 90)

| 中文 | English |
|:---|:---|
| 之后：`+[UIVisualEffect cyl_effectWithThemeProvider:]`（`UIVisualEffect+CYLTheme.h`）。`UIVisualEffect` 的 `-copy` 返回自身，所以用 `NSKeyedArchiver` 归档再解档得到新对象，`UIVisualEffectView.effect` 与 Bar appearance 的 `backgroundEffect` 在主题切换时换成新主题的效果。扣分（−10）：自定义的 `UIVisualEffect` 子类若不支持 `NSSecureCoding`，退化为在原对象上记信息（仍能工作，但该对象若被多个主题共享会互相覆盖）。 | After: `+[UIVisualEffect cyl_effectWithThemeProvider:]` (`UIVisualEffect+CYLTheme.h`). `-copy` on a `UIVisualEffect` returns the receiver, so a new object is made by archiving and unarchiving with `NSKeyedArchiver`; `UIVisualEffectView.effect` and the bar appearances' `backgroundEffect` get the new theme's effect on a theme change. Deduction (−10): a custom `UIVisualEffect` subclass without `NSSecureCoding` falls back to storing the info on the object itself (it still works, but if that object is shared by several themes they overwrite each other). |

### [CN]1.4 layer 颜色（40 → 92 分）
### [EN]1.4 Layer colors (40 → 92)

| 中文 | English |
|:---|:---|
| 之前：文档要求在回调中重设 `CGColor`（40 分：能做到，但每个 layer 都要手写）。QMUI 通过 hook `CALayer` 的 setter 自动完成。 | Before: the doc asked you to set the `CGColor` again in the callback (40: possible, but hand-written for every layer). QMUI does it by hooking the `CALayer` setters. |
| 之后：`-[CALayer cyl_setThemeColor:forKey:]`（`CALayer+CYLTheme.h`）记住 `UIColor`，立即写入 `CGColor`，并在两处自动重写：主题切换时（`UIView (CYLTheme)` 对本视图 layer 及其不属于其他视图的 sublayer 调用 `-cyl_updateThemeColors`）；iOS 17+ 的深色模式变化时（`-registerForTraitChanges:`，每个 layer 只注册一次）。不 hook `CALayer`。扣分（−8）：iOS 16 及以前，深色模式变化只能经由 `respondsSystemStyleAutomatically` 的主题切换到达 layer。 | After: `-[CALayer cyl_setThemeColor:forKey:]` (`CALayer+CYLTheme.h`) remembers the `UIColor`, writes the `CGColor` at once, and writes it again in two places: on a theme change (`UIView (CYLTheme)` calls `-cyl_updateThemeColors` on the view's layer and on its sublayers that belong to no other view), and on iOS 17+ when Dark Mode changes (`-registerForTraitChanges:`, once per layer). No `CALayer` hook. Deduction (−8): before iOS 17 a Dark Mode change reaches a layer only through a theme change (`respondsSystemStyleAutomatically`). |

### [CN]1.5 自动刷新（70 → 94 分）
### [EN]1.5 Automatic refresh (70 → 94)

| 中文 | English |
|:---|:---|
| 之前：只有主题切换时位于可见 window 上的视图收到回调；未选中 Tab 的页面、导航栈下层页面、暂时移除的视图都收不到，它们的主题颜色靠动态颜色自愈，但注册过的属性不会更新。 | Before: only views in a visible window when the theme changed got the callback; pages of unselected tabs, pages below the top of a navigation stack and views removed for a while got nothing. Their theme colors healed as dynamic colors, but registered properties did not update. |
| 之后三层补齐：① `UIViewController (CYLTheme)` 对已加载但不在任何 window 中的 `view` 主动遍历（未选中 Tab、导航栈下层）；② `CYLThemeTrackView()` 以弱引用记住注册过属性、设置过 layer 颜色、或上次切换时发现持有主题图片 / 效果的视图，管理器在遍历 window 后再遍历它们；③ 每次切换编号（`CYLThemeBeginChange()`），一个视图从 window、控制器、记住的视图多处到达时只更新一次。扣分（−6）：从未进入视图树、也未注册的视图中的主题图片在它第一次显示前不会更新（颜色会，因为是动态的）。 | After, three additions: ① `UIViewController (CYLTheme)` walks a loaded `view` that is in no window (unselected tabs, pages below the top of a stack); ② `CYLThemeTrackView()` remembers, weakly, every view that registered properties, set a layer color, or was found holding a theme image / effect on a previous change, and the manager walks them after the windows; ③ every change is numbered (`CYLThemeBeginChange()`), so a view reached from its window, its controller and the tracked views is updated once. Deduction (−6): a theme image in a view that was never in a view tree and never registered is not updated before its first display (colors are, being dynamic). |

### [CN]1.6 测试与截图（60 → 90 分；截图 0 分）
### [EN]1.6 Tests and screenshots (60 → 90; screenshots 0)

| 中文 | English |
|:---|:---|
| 测试：`CYLThemeTests`（8 个，#773 合入）覆盖管理器与颜色；本次新增 `CYLThemeValueTests`（6 个）覆盖主题图片是新对象且保留内容、`UIImageView` / `UIButton` 各状态替换、模糊效果替换、layer 颜色与 sublayer、离屏视图经记住的视图到达、Bar appearance 的图片与效果。在 iPhone 15 Pro（iOS 17.5）模拟器上 14 个全部通过。截图：文档「测试与截图」仍写着在 Linux 上完成、没有截图；本仓库现在有模拟器，应补。 | Tests: `CYLThemeTests` (8, merged with #773) cover the manager and the colors; this commit adds `CYLThemeValueTests` (6): a theme image is a new object that keeps its content, every `UIImageView` / `UIButton` state is replaced, a blur effect is replaced, layer colors and sublayers, an off-screen view reached through the tracked views, and the images and effects of a bar appearance. All 14 pass on the iPhone 15 Pro (iOS 17.5) simulator. Screenshots: the doc's "Testing and screenshots" still says the work was done on Linux with no screenshot; a simulator is available now, so they are owed. |

## [CN]2. 与动画组件的集成：逐项评估（72 分）
## [EN]2. Integration with the animation components, area by area (72)

| 中文 | English |
|:---|:---|
| 现状（事实，来自代码）：① `CYLTabBarTheme` 的 `-cyl_tabBarItemsAttributesForTabBarController:` 经 `-updateTabBarItemsWithAttributes:` → `-updateTabBarItemAtIndex:attributes:` 应用，而后者只处理标题、图片、颜色等静态 key，**不处理 `CYLTabBarAnimationURL` / `CYLTabBarLottieURL` 等动画 key**，所以主题换不了 Tab 的动画文件；② `CYLTabBarItemAnimationEngine` 只有 `styleSource`（#442 深色模式的文件变体与 `…DarkColors`），引擎与播放器协议里没有任何"主题"概念；③ `CYLTabBarController` 的 `traitCollectionDidChange:` 同时触发主题（`updateThemesForTraitCollection:`）与动画深色变体，但主题切换本身（`cyl_themeDidChangeByManager:`）不触发动画刷新；④ Example-Rive、Example-PAG、Example-SwiftUI-Rive 共用的 Swift 测试列表（`Example-Shared/CYLSettingsDemoTableViewController.swift`）没有"换肤"行，三种动画库都无法在 Demo 里验证换肤。 | Today (facts from the code): ① `CYLTabBarTheme`'s `-cyl_tabBarItemsAttributesForTabBarController:` is applied through `-updateTabBarItemsWithAttributes:` → `-updateTabBarItemAtIndex:attributes:`, which handles the static keys (title, images, colors) and **none of the animation keys** (`CYLTabBarAnimationURL` / `CYLTabBarLottieURL`, ...), so a theme cannot swap a tab's animation file; ② `CYLTabBarItemAnimationEngine` has a `styleSource` only (#442: the Dark Mode file variant and `…DarkColors`); nothing in the engine or player protocols knows about themes; ③ `CYLTabBarController`'s `traitCollectionDidChange:` triggers both the themes (`updateThemesForTraitCollection:`) and the animations' dark variants, but a theme change itself (`cyl_themeDidChangeByManager:`) triggers no animation refresh; ④ the Swift test list shared by Example-Rive, Example-PAG and Example-SwiftUI-Rive (`Example-Shared/CYLSettingsDemoTableViewController.swift`) has no "Skin" row, so none of the three libraries can be checked for theming in a demo. |

| 库 / Library | 得分 / Score | 能做 / Works | 不能做 / Missing |
|:---|:---:|:---|:---|
| Lottie | 70 | 深色模式文件变体、`CYLTabBarLottieDarkColors` 的 value provider、循环播放在主题切换后仍正常（`cyl_updateLoopingLottieViews`）/ Dark Mode file variant, `CYLTabBarLottieDarkColors` value providers, looping survives a theme change (`cyl_updateLoopingLottieViews`) | 主题换文件；主题颜色进 value provider / theme file swap; theme colors into value providers |
| PAG | 72 | 深色模式文件变体 / Dark Mode file variant | 主题换文件（PAG 本身无颜色覆盖，所以只差这一项）/ theme file swap (PAG has no color override, so only this) |
| Rive | 70 | 深色模式文件变体、`CYLTabBarRiveDarkColors` 的 view model 颜色 / Dark Mode file variant, `CYLTabBarRiveDarkColors` view-model colors | 主题换文件；主题颜色进 view model / theme file swap; theme colors into the view model |

## [CN]3. 架构维度评估
## [EN]3. Architecture dimensions

| 维度 / Dimension | 换肤组件 / Theme | 动画组件 / Animation | 两者接缝 / Seam | 说明 / Notes |
|:---|:---:|:---:|:---:|:---|
| 兼容性 / Compatibility | 92 | 95 | 80 | 换肤：iOS 9+ 可编译，13+ 动态颜色，17+ layer 跟随深色；动画：三库各自 `__has_include` 隔离、key 预编译保护（#604）；接缝：主题与动画都能跟随深色模式，但只有深色模式这一条通路 / Theme: compiles on iOS 9+, dynamic colors 13+, layers follow Dark Mode 17+; animation: each library isolated by `__has_include`, compile-time key guards (#604); seam: both follow Dark Mode, and Dark Mode is the only shared path |
| 健壮性 / Robustness | 93 | 92 | 70 | 换肤：不 hook，弱引用表，切换编号去重，provider 嵌套上限 8 层；动画：空视图、无库时静默；接缝：主题提供动画 key 时被静默忽略，没有日志 / Theme: no hooks, weak table, numbered changes, provider nesting capped at 8; animation: tolerates missing views and libraries; seam: animation keys from a theme are dropped silently, no log |
| 扩展性 / Extensibility | 90 | 95 | 60 | 换肤：新增一种主题值 = 一个分类 + `CYLThemeRefreshedValue()` 一个分支；动画：新增动画库 = 一个 animator + 一个播放器；接缝：想让主题影响动画，目前只能在 `-cyl_customizeTabBarController:` 里手动操作每个 Tab 按钮 / Theme: a new kind of theme value is one category plus one branch in `CYLThemeRefreshedValue()`; animation: a new library is one animator plus one player; seam: to make a theme affect an animation today you drive each tab button by hand in `-cyl_customizeTabBarController:` |
| 面向接口 / Programming to interfaces | 90 | 96 | 55 | 换肤：`CYLTabBarTheme` 协议、provider block；动画：`CYLTabBarItemAnimator`、`CYLTabBarItemAnimationPlayer`、`CYLTabBarItemAnimationStyleSource` 四个协议分角色；接缝：没有"主题 → 动画"的协议 / Theme: the `CYLTabBarTheme` protocol and provider blocks; animation: four role-split protocols; seam: no "theme → animation" protocol |
| 依赖反转 / Dependency inversion | 88 | 96 | 60 | 换肤：`CYLTabBarController (CYLTheme)` 依赖 `CYLThemeManagerCenter` 具体类（可注入性弱）；动画：引擎依赖注册表、工厂、样式源三个抽象，可注入；接缝：`traitCollectionDidChange:` 直接调用 `CYLThemeManagerCenter` 与 `CYLTabBarItemAnimationDefaultStyleSource()` 两个单例 / Theme: `CYLTabBarController (CYLTheme)` depends on the concrete `CYLThemeManagerCenter` (weak injectability); animation: the engine depends on three abstractions (registry, factory, style source) and is injectable; seam: `traitCollectionDidChange:` calls the two singletons `CYLThemeManagerCenter` and `CYLTabBarItemAnimationDefaultStyleSource()` directly |
| 解耦 / Decoupling | 92 | 95 | 75 | 换肤在 `CYLUtils/CYLComponents/CYLTheme/` 自成一体，Core 只通过 `cyl_themeDidChangeByManager:` 接入；动画在 `CYLTabBarItemAnimation/` 自成一体；接缝的耦合都在 `CYLTabBarController.m` 一个文件里（`CYLTheme` 分类、`traitCollectionDidChange:`、`cyl_updateLoopingLottieViews`），未分到 `CYLTabBarController+CYLTheme.m` / Theming is self-contained in `CYLUtils/CYLComponents/CYLTheme/` and Core joins through `cyl_themeDidChangeByManager:`; animation is self-contained in `CYLTabBarItemAnimation/`; all the seam coupling sits in the one file `CYLTabBarController.m` (the `CYLTheme` category, `traitCollectionDidChange:`, `cyl_updateLoopingLottieViews`), not yet split into `CYLTabBarController+CYLTheme.m` |

## [CN]4. 是否符合最初的架构设计
## [EN]4. Does it meet the original architecture?

| 中文 | English |
|:---|:---|
| 最初设计（见 [docs/Theme-Switching.md](Theme-Switching.md) 与 [docs/Tab-Bar-Item-Animation.md](Tab-Bar-Item-Animation.md)）有三条原则：**不 hook UIKit**（与其他库共存）；**TabBar 原地更新**（不重建 TabBar、不重建控制器）；**动画库可插拔**（引擎只认协议，库在 `+load` 注册）。 | The original design (see [docs/Theme-Switching.md](Theme-Switching.md) and [docs/Tab-Bar-Item-Animation.md](Tab-Bar-Item-Animation.md)) has three principles: **no UIKit hooks** (coexist with other libraries); **the tab bar updates in place** (no new tab bar, no new view controllers); **animation libraries are pluggable** (the engine sees protocols, a library registers in `+load`). |
| 符合：本次新增的图片、效果、layer 三种主题值都没有引入 hook，自动刷新用"记住视图 + 编号去重"代替了 QMUI 的 hook；TabBar 换肤仍是原地的；动画组件未被改动。 | Met: the three new kinds of theme value (images, effects, layers) add no hook, and automatic refresh uses "remember the view + numbered changes" instead of QMUI's hooks; tab bar theming is still in place; the animation component is untouched. |
| 不符合的一点：**"原地更新"对动画 Tab 不成立**。`CYLTabBarTheme` 承诺"切换主题即可原地更新 TabBar"，但带 Lottie / PAG / Rive 图标的 Tab 在换肤后只会换掉静态占位图，动画视图原封不动——换肤对动画 Tab 的承诺没有兑现。 | One miss: **"in place" does not hold for an animated tab**. `CYLTabBarTheme` promises that "switching the theme restyles the tab bar in place", but a tab with a Lottie / PAG / Rive icon only gets its static placeholder image swapped; the animation view stays as it was. The promise is not kept for animated tabs. |

## [CN]5. 改进建议（按收益排序）
## [EN]5. Improvements, by payoff

| # | 改进 / Improvement | 收益 / Gain | 改动 / Change | 公开 API / Public API |
|:---:|:---|:---:|:---|:---|
| 1 | `-updateTabBarItemAtIndex:attributes:` 处理动画 key：有 `CYLTabBarAnimationURL` / `…FilePath`（及各库别名）时，经 `CYLTabBarItemAnimationEngine` 用新 URL 替换该 Tab 的动画视图（引擎已有 `replaceAnimationInControl:withURL:` 一类能力，#442 深色变体就是这样换的）/ handle the animation keys in `-updateTabBarItemAtIndex:attributes:`: with `CYLTabBarAnimationURL` / `…FilePath` (or a library alias), replace the tab's animation view through the engine with the new URL (the engine already swaps views this way for the #442 dark variant) | 集成 72 → 88；三库同时受益；主题从此能换动画文件 / integration 72 → 88; all three libraries benefit; a theme can swap the animation file | `CYLTabBarController.m` 约 30 行；一个测试 / ~30 lines in `CYLTabBarController.m`; one test | 不变（key 已存在）/ none (the keys exist) |
| 2 | 新增通用 key `CYLTabBarAnimationColors`（keypath → `UIColor`，值可为主题颜色），引擎在主题切换与深色变化时都调用播放器现有的 `applyDarkColors:traitCollection:`（改名为通用的 `applyColors:traitCollection:` 并保留旧名）；主题颜色经 `cyl_rawColor` 解析 / a generic `CYLTabBarAnimationColors` key (keypath → `UIColor`, theme colors allowed); the engine calls the players' existing `applyDarkColors:traitCollection:` (renamed to a generic `applyColors:traitCollection:`, old name kept) on a theme change as well as on a Dark Mode change; theme colors resolve through `cyl_rawColor` | 集成 88 → 95；Lottie 与 Rive 的颜色跟随主题 / integration 88 → 95; Lottie and Rive colors follow the theme | 引擎 + Lottie / Rive 播放器各一处；`CYLTabBarController (CYLTheme)` 在应用主题后调用引擎刷新 / one spot in the engine and in the Lottie / Rive players; `CYLTabBarController (CYLTheme)` asks the engine to refresh after applying a theme | 新增 1 个 key、1 个可选协议方法；旧方法保留 / 1 new key, 1 optional protocol method; old methods kept |
| 3 | `Example-Shared/CYLSettingsDemoTableViewController.swift` 加"换肤"行（复用 `UIViewController (CYLThemeSettings)` 的 `-cyl_presentThemePicker`），Example-Rive / PAG / SwiftUI-Rive 可演示并截图 / add a "Skin" row to `Example-Shared/CYLSettingsDemoTableViewController.swift` (reuse `-cyl_presentThemePicker` of `UIViewController (CYLThemeSettings)`), so Example-Rive / PAG / SwiftUI-Rive can demonstrate and screenshot it | 截图 0 → 100；三库的换肤可见 / screenshots 0 → 100; theming visible in all three | Swift 约 10 行 + 4 张截图 / ~10 lines of Swift + 4 screenshots | 不变 / none |
| 4 | `CYLTabBarController (CYLTheme)`、`traitCollectionDidChange:` 中的主题部分、`cyl_updateLoopingLottieViews` 拆到 `CYLTabBarController+CYLTheme.m`；主题管理器经 `CYLThemeManagerCenter` 之外的可注入入口（`cyl_themeManager` 属性，默认 `defaultThemeManager`）/ split `CYLTabBarController (CYLTheme)`, the theme part of `traitCollectionDidChange:` and `cyl_updateLoopingLottieViews` into `CYLTabBarController+CYLTheme.m`; make the manager injectable (a `cyl_themeManager` property defaulting to `defaultThemeManager`) | 依赖反转 88 → 94，解耦 92 → 96 / dependency inversion 88 → 94, decoupling 92 → 96 | 搬文件；1 个属性 / a file move; 1 property | 新增 1 个属性 / 1 new property |
| 5 | 主题提供了动画 key 但没有动画库时打一条 `🔴` 日志（与 #618 的数量不一致日志同风格）/ log a `🔴` line when a theme gives animation keys and no animation library is linked (the style of the #618 mismatch log) | 健壮性（接缝）70 → 85 / seam robustness 70 → 85 | 5 行 / 5 lines | 不变 / none |

| 中文 | English |
|:---|:---|
| 建议顺序：1 → 3 → 2 → 5 → 4。第 1 项最小、收益最大，且是第 2 项的前提；第 3 项让后续每一步都能在三种动画库的 Demo 中看见；第 4 项是纯结构整理，放最后。 | Suggested order: 1 → 3 → 2 → 5 → 4. Item 1 is the smallest with the largest gain and a prerequisite of item 2; item 3 makes every later step visible in the three animation demos; item 4 is structure only and goes last. |
